blocks.title: NP-complete
blocks.text: NP-complete masail NP mein bhi hain aur NP ke sab se mushkil masail jitne mushkil bhi. Agar koi ek NP-complete masla kaarkardagi se hal ho jaye to har NP masla ho sakta hai.

Misal: knapsack masla. Thaile ki zyada se zyada wazan ki gunjaish hai aur har cheez ka wazan aur qeemat hai; maqsad gunjaish se zyada na hone wala sab se qeemti mel hai. Pesh kiya gaya majmooa jaanchna aasan hai (wazan aur qeematein jama karein), magar behtareen mel dhoondna mushkil hai kyunke mel ki tadaad cheezon ke saath exponential barhti hai, to brute force jald na-qabil-e-amal ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Venn diagram: oopar bara daira NP-Hard neeche wale daire NP par chadha hua hai; dono ka mushtarka hissa NP-Complete hai. NP ke andar neeche chhota baizawi daira P hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P poora NP ke andar hai: jo masla jaldi hal ho sakta hai us ka jawab jaldi jaancha bhi ja sakta hai. NP-Complete woh hissa hai jo NP mein bhi hai aur NP-Hard mein bhi, jaise knapsack masla. NP-Hard ka baqi hissa NP se bahar hai: woh masail kam az kam NP-Complete jitne mushkil hain magar zaroori nahi ke un ka jawab jaldi jaancha ja sake.
Kya P NP ke barabar hai, yeh computer science ke sab se aham hal na hue masail mein se hai, jis ke cryptography, algorithm design aur computational complexity par bare asraat hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Complexity classes P, NP, NP-hard aur NP-complete aur un ki ahmiyat par baat kijiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: P: polynomial waqt mein hal (sorting). NP: pesh kiya gaya hal polynomial waqt mein jaancha ja sake (Sudoku); P NP ke andar hai. NP-hard: kam az kam har NP masle jitna mushkil, aur zaroori nahi NP mein ho (TSP). NP-complete: NP ke woh masail jo NP-hard bhi hain (knapsack). Classes batati hain ke kaarkard durust algorithm ki umeed karein ya nahi: P masail ke liye durust algorithms, jabke NP-hard aur NP-complete ke liye takhmeeni hal, heuristics ya chhote inputs. Agar P = NP saabit ho jaye to tamam NP masail kaarkardagi se hal-pazeer ho jayenge, jis ka asar cryptography par hoga.

items: NP-complete: NP mein aur NP-hard (knapsack); ek ka kaarkard hal tamam NP masail hal kar dega.
P NP ke andar; NP-complete wahan jahan NP aur NP-hard milte hain; P banam NP hal nahi hua.
